explanation: This tests normal acceleration in vector-function calculus, which is absent from the supplied Linear Algebra topics; the use of dot products is incidental. Thus it is prerequisite. At t=1, v=⟨-1,1,1⟩ and a=v'=⟨-2,0,1⟩. The tangential acceleration is (v·a)/|v|=3/√3=√3, so the normal acceleration is √(|a|²−3)=√(5−3)=√2 m/s².
